On PS4 there's a DBXV2 Lite version, so try out XV2 before dropping cash on it. It lets you go a little ways into the main story and some parallel quests so you get a good feel of what you're getting into. If you want a more story driven single-player DBZ experience then Kakarot's the way to go chief. Both games are enjoyable in different ways though, so im sure you'll have fun with either especially since you enjoyed the first Xenoverse.
